description: FREE search for paid API endpoints (x402) by task. Pass either a natural-language query (the planner will split it) or pre-split queries[]. Returns a structured plan with up to `maxRoutesPerQuery` candidates per sub-query. No auth. Limits: burst 200/10s, total 1000/15min per IP; free probes 10/h per IP, 20/h per agent. IMPORTANT: Do not fetch `route.url` directly. To execute the preferred route, call `call_endpoint({ routeId, arguments })` — `routeId` from `plan[].routes[].routeId`, `arguments` keys = `parameters[].name` of that route.

budget.description: Optional filter to exclude expensive plans. If the cheapest possible plan (estimate.minPlanCost) exceeds maxTotalPrice, the plan is still returned but estimate.overBudget=true.

currency.description: Currency for maxTotalPrice. Defaults to USDC.

maxTotalPrice.description: Maximum total price for the recommended routes, in `currency`. Set it to skip plans that are too expensive for your task.

maxRoutesPerQuery.description: Max alternative routes returned per sub-query. Controls how many candidates you get to choose from; does not affect the discovery fee. Clamped to [1,5].

queries.description: Optional pre-split sub-queries. If provided, takes precedence over `query` and bypasses the LLM planner (so faster). Use only when you already know the decomposition; otherwise omit and pass `query`.

query.description: Natural-language task. Pass the whole task in one call; the planner splits it into sub-queries automatically. Ignored if `queries` is provided.

name: search_endpoints

budget.description: Echo of the budget applied to this search (may have maxTotalPrice=null if not provided).

minPlanCost.description: Sum of the cheapest route price per step — the minimum needed to cover every step.

overBudget.description: True if minPlanCost exceeds budget.maxTotalPrice. The plan is still returned.

planTotal.description: Sum of route.price over all recommended routes.

maxPricePerRoute.description: Hard filter applied during search: routes with price > this value were excluded before ranking.

plan.description: Ordered steps. Each step groups candidate routes for one sub-query. Empty array means no matching endpoints were found.

schema.description: JSON Schema for this parameter, as declared in the upstream OpenAPI spec.

price.description: Price per call of this route, in USDC. Charged by call_endpoint, not by search_endpoints.

score.description: RAG distance (lower = better match). Routes are sorted by score within each step.

url.description: URL of the endpoint on x402helper.xyz. Do not fetch it directly — pass routeId to call_endpoint instead, which handles payment and required arguments.

status.description: recommended — route is indexed and its parameters/requestBody are known; safe to pass routeId to call_endpoint. unresolved — route came from search but is missing from the local index; its contract is unknown and call_endpoint will likely fail. Prefer another route in the same step.
